fastin.description: Read all of stdin as tokens (huge inputs; not for interactive problems)
body: # Reads all of stdin at once: fastest for huge inputs, but replaces input()/ints() and hangs on interactive problems.
# Interactive: flush every line you print and read replies with input(); never read all of stdin.

deeprec.description: Run the testcase loop with a raised recursion limit and a large thread stack
body: # Replaces the loop at the bottom. CPython 3.12+ only needs the raised limit; PyPy also needs the big stack.
# @cache stops at ~3,300 levels on CPython 3.12/3.13 whatever the limit: memoize deeper recursion in a dict.

bootstrap.description: Decorator that runs generator-based recursion on the heap

antihash.description: Random salt against anti-hash tests on dict/set/Counter int keys
body: # Codeforces hacks pick int keys that all collide in dict/set/Counter (int hashes aren't randomized),
# turning O(1) lookups into O(n). Store x ^ SALT instead of x; xor again to recover x.
